title: Web3 Game Engine
tagline: Game engine for building web3 games and metaverse experiences
description: This project shows the potential of a web3 game engine.  The tools provided by the engine dramatically simplify the steps required to build web3 enabled games or metaverse experiences. Game developers and artists can get right to building without having to become a blockchain expert.
how_its_made: This project builds on top of the open source game engine Godot. The plugin source code is written in C++. The only additional dependency is the Trezor crypto library needed for Keccak hashing and ECDSA private key signatures.  Polygon was used to build a demo project.  Their extremely low gas fees and EVM compatibility made it an obvious choice to build on.
